description: A batter's record against a bowler in men's T20: legal balls faced, runs, dismissals credited to the bowler, strike rate, average, dots and boundaries, with a breakdown by competition. 266,764 pairs from 9,132 matches (IPL, internationals and eleven leagues) through 17 Sep 2026. Per call.

batter.description: Batter's name as match records write it, e.g. "V Kohli". Part of a name matches; the answer says who was used and who else matched.

bowler.description: Bowler's name, the same way, e.g. "SP Narine".

name: hsh-cricket-matchup
